CVE-2026-53669 (open redirect in react-router) affects >=6.0.0 <7.18.0 and is fixed only in react-router 7.18.0. Trigger.dev's self-hosted webapp is a Remix v2 application whose @remix-run/router 1.x dependency pins react-router to 6.x (DHI resolves 6.30.6). The fix (7.18.0) is a breaking major incompatible with Remix v2. Tracking upstream migration to react-router 7 / Remix v3 and assessing redirect reachability in the self-hosted webapp.

CVE-2026-53666 (unsafe reflection in react-router) affects >=6.4.0 <7.18.0 and is fixed only in react-router 7.18.0. Trigger.dev's self-hosted webapp (apps/webapp) is a Remix v2 application; @remix-run/router 1.x and @remix-run/react 2.x pin react-router to the 6.x line (DHI resolves 6.30.6). The only upstream fix, 7.18.0, is a breaking major incompatible with the Remix v2 stack; adopting it requires Trigger.dev to migrate off Remix v2. Tracking upstream migration to react-router 7 / Remix v3 and assessing whether the affected data-router code path is reachable in the self-hosted webapp.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 requires react-router 8.3.0, which is a major version upgrade from 7.x. The vulnerability affects unstable RSC APIs only. Evaluating compatibility and migration path for the major version jump. Current version 7.18.0 addresses other high and medium severity CVEs in the 7.x line.
